errors.quote: A pesar del fracaso de la huelga del centenario de la independencia y la posterior represión, la FORA logró difundir ampliamente las ideas libertarias
errors.reason: The 1910 centenary strike failure and repression came after the growth and golden age (24:00-24:19 says it led to the anarchists' displacement, to be covered in the next episode), so the 'despite... managed to spread' ordering reverses the chronology.

errors.quote: aunque finalmente se vio debilitada por conflictos internos y la competencia de otras corrientes obreras
errors.reason: The video only hints at the weakening and defers it to the next episode (31:05-31:18), mentioning competition from other currents and the repression; the internal split is described as FORA's 9th congress dispute (13:19-13:46), not as the cause of a final decline.

errors.quote: el video examina el auge y la caída de esta importante fase del anarquismo argentino
errors.reason: The video covers the rise and golden age and only foreshadows the decline, which it says it will analyze in the next episode (24:19-24:21, 31:15-31:18).
